query: Low GPU utilization / heavy memory swapping during WanVideoSampler on VRAM-limited setups (720p 30f uses 6GB; attention memory design can't sustain 720p 100f on 8GB) — attention implementation keeps full K/V and doesn't chunk Q, so long-sequence attention is memory-bound.

desired.outcome: OP's own fix (applied to comfy/ldm/wan/model.py in Comfy core): keep only complete K and V in memory and compute attention for Q in chunks — 720p/120f then fits in ~4GB with high CUDA utilization (~90min for 6 steps on RTX 5050). Commenter (redomsu76) corroborated the symptom on a 5060 Ti but the fix was never ported to the wrapper or confirmed by the maintainer.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: OP's own fix (applied to comfy/ldm/wan/model.py in Comfy core): keep only complete K and V in memory and compute attention for Q in chunks — 720p/120f then fits in ~4GB with high CUDA utilization (~90min for 6 steps on RTX 5050). desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Implement Q-chunked attention (keep full K/V, chunk Q) in comfy/ldm/wan/model.py to cut long-sequence attention memory on low-VRAM GPUs.
